request.subject: UNIT:GUARD

layers.text: Redraw him as a heavy armoured guard behind a giant kite-shaped pavise shield, nearly as tall as he is and wider than his body, crimson with a big gold cross and a thick steel border: only his helmeted head, one big steel pauldron and his steel plate boots show round it; heavy polished steel plate armour; a braced, wide, low stance. Keep the face, the kettle helmet with its gold band, the upright spear, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
